content_html:
Food Scanner & Macro Counter

Only for iPhone

Free · In‑App Purchases · Designed for iPhone. Not verified for macOS.

iPhone

Tired of bloated calorie apps? YouCal is the AI calorie tracker and food tracker built for real results. Log any meal in seconds, track your macros, hit your calorie deficit, and run intermittent fasting in the same app. THE CALORIE COUNTER BUILT FOR TODAY Type a meal, scan a barcode, or snap a photo - your calorie counter updates instantly with accurate macro data. YouCal does the hard work so you can log a full meal in under 30 seconds. Whether you want to lose weight, build muscle, or simply eat better, this calorie tracker gives you everything you need without the clutter. INTERMITTENT FASTING - BUILT IN Track your eating window without leaving the app. YouCal includes a full intermittent fasting tracker with the protocols you actually use: • 14:10, 16:8, 18:6, OMAD (23h), 24h, or any custom duration • One-tap start from the same + menu you use for food • Apple Health-style circular timer - drag to fine-tune • Lock-screen Live Activity tracks your fast even when the app is closed • Cross-day fasts handled cleanly - Mon 9 PM → Tue 9 AM with full context • Streak counter, weekly chart, longest-fast record • Quick post-fast note and full history with one-tap delete If you do 16:8, OMAD, or any intermittent fasting protocol, you no longer need a separate fasting app. WHAT MAKES YOUCAL DIFFERENT ◦ AI Food Calorie Tracker - Type, scan, or snap. Real nutrition data instantly. Zero guesswork. ◦ Macro Tracker - Track protein, carbs, and fat for every meal. Stay on target whether you're keto, building muscle, or cutting. ◦ Calorie Deficit Calculator - Personalised daily target based on your weight, height, age, and goals. Updates in real time. ◦ Barcode Scanner - Scan any packaged food for exact calorie and macro data instantly. No manual entry needed. ◦ Water Tracker - Log daily water intake alongside your food. Hydration as visible as your calorie count. ◦ Workout Library - Browse cardio, strength, and flexibility workouts. Calories burned estimated by BMI. ◦ Progress Dashboard - One view for calories, macros, workouts, fasting, and hydration. ◦ Smart Notifications & Streaks - Personalised reminders and streak tracking that build the habit without nagging. WHO IS YOUCAL FOR? • Anyone trying to lose weight with an accurate calorie counter • Athletes tracking macros for protein, carbs, and fat targets • Keto dieters who need precise daily macro tracking • People doing intermittent fasting who want fasting and calories in one app • Beginners who want a simple food tracker without complexity • Busy people who need to log meals in under 30 seconds WHY YOUCAL Most food tracker apps are overbuilt and slow. YouCal is the AI calorie tracker built for today - fast logging, an instant barcode scanner, and a calorie counter that stays out of your way. At just 41MB, it downloads instantly on cellular. No ads. No distractions. Subscription Required - YouCal is available as a subscription with a 3-day free trial. All pricing is displayed in the app before purchase. Medical Disclaimer: YouCal provides general health, fitness, and nutrition information for educational purposes only. It does not offer medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before making decisions related to your health. 食品扫描仪和宏观计数器

仅适用于 iPhone

免费 · 应用内购买 · 专为 iPhone 设计。 未针对 macOS 进行验证。

iPhone

厌倦了臃肿的卡路里应用程序？ YouCal 是一款人工智能卡路里追踪器和食物追踪器，专为真实结果而打造。 在几秒钟内记录任何膳食，跟踪您的宏指令，达到卡路里赤字，并在同一个应用程序中进行间歇性禁食。 专为当今而设计的卡路里计数器键入膳食、扫描条形码或拍摄照片 - 您的卡路里计数器会立即更新并提供准确的宏观数据。 YouCal 做了艰苦的工作，因此您可以在 30 秒内记录一顿正餐。 无论您是想减肥、增强肌肉，还是只是想吃得更好，这款卡路里追踪器都能为您提供所需的一切，而不会造成混乱。 间歇性禁食 - 内置跟踪您的饮食窗口，无需离开应用程序。 YouCal 包含一个完整的间歇性禁食跟踪器，其中包含您实际使用的协议： • 14:10、16:8、18:6、OMAD (23 小时)、24 小时或任何自定义持续时间 • 从与食物相同的 + 菜单一键启动 • Apple Health 风格的循环计时器 - 拖动进行微调 • 即使应用程序关闭，锁屏实时活动也会跟踪您的禁食 • 干净地处理跨日禁食 - 周一晚上 9 点 → 周二上午 9 点，提供完整背景 • 连胜次数计数器、每周图表、最长禁食记录 • 快速禁食后记录和完整历史记录，一键删除 如果您执行 16:8、OMAD 或任何间歇性禁食方案，您不再需要单独的禁食应用程序。 是什么让您与众不同 ◦ AI 食物卡路里追踪器 - 键入、扫描或拍照。 即时真实的营养数据。 零猜测。 ◦ 宏观跟踪器 - 跟踪每餐的蛋白质、碳水化合物和脂肪。 无论您是生酮、增肌还是减脂，都要坚持目标。 ◦ 卡路里不足计算器 - 根据您的体重、身高、年龄和目标个性化每日目标。 实时更新。 ◦ 条形码扫描仪 - 立即扫描任何包装食品以获取准确的卡路里和宏观数据。 无需手动输入。 ◦ 饮水跟踪器 - 记录每天的饮水量和食物摄入量。 水分含量与您的卡路里计数一样明显。 ◦ 锻炼库 - 浏览有氧运动、力量和灵活性锻炼。 根据 BMI 估算消耗的卡路里。 ◦ 进度仪表板 - 卡路里、宏指令、锻炼、禁食和水分的单一视图。 ◦ 智能通知和连续记录 - 个性化提醒和连续跟踪，让您养成习惯，无需烦扰。 YOUCAL适合谁？ • 任何试图通过准确的卡路里计数器减肥的人 • 跟踪蛋白质、碳水化合物和脂肪目标宏的运动员 • 需要精确每日宏跟踪的酮类节食者 • 进行间歇性禁食的人，希望在一个应用程序中实现禁食和卡路里 • 想要一个简单且不复杂的食物追踪器的初学者 • 需要在 30 秒内记录膳食的忙碌人士 为什么 YOUCAL 大多数食物追踪器应用程序都过度构建且速度缓慢。 YouCal 是专为当今时代打造的 AI 卡路里追踪器 - 快速记录、即时条形码扫描仪和不妨碍您的卡路里计数器。 它的大小仅为 41MB，可以在蜂窝网络上立即下载。 没有广告。 没有干扰。 需要订阅 - YouCal 可作为订阅使用，并提供 3 天免费试用。 所有定价均在购买前显示在应用程序中。 医疗免责声明：YouCal 提供一般健康、健身和营养信息仅用于教育目的。 它不提供医疗建议。 在做出与您的健康相关的决定之前，请务必咨询合格的医疗保健专业人员。 使用条款：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 隐私政策：https://youcal-legal-pages.web.app/privacy-policy.html 建议来源：https://youcal-legal-pages.web.app/source-of-recommendations.html
